entities.summary: Muslim Gamzatovich Gadzhimagomedov is a Russian professional boxer who has held the World Boxing Association (WBA) bridgerweight title since 2024. As an amateur, he won a gold medal at the 2019 World Championships and 2019 European Games. Gadzhimagomedov also won silver medals at both the 2020 Summer Olympics and 2017 European Championships.
